w10_T4_002972: In the morning Liam unloaded 39 boxes for the cake stall; each box held 4 trays, and each tray held 9 mini cupcakes, all of which went onto his counter. He then added 70 mini cupcakes from a spare tin. In the afternoon he cut every mini cupcake on the counter into 3 tasting pieces, and packed the pieces into bags of 3. In the evening his sister brought 30 more bags of the same pieces to add to his stock. How many bags did Liam have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_002980: Coach Maria's swimming club had 195 members, and 48 more joined in January. Every member paid a 5-dollar entry fee for the spring gala, and a local shop donated 45 dollars on top. The club was founded 20 years ago. The gala cost 284 dollars to run, which came out of the fee money. Coach Diego's club raised less for its own gala than Maria's club. How many dollars did Maria's club have left after paying for the gala?
w10_T4_002981: In the morning a mill delivered 60 kilograms of flour to be shared equally among 5 bakeries, and Pia's bakery took its share. Later that morning Pia bought 35 kilograms more, and a neighbour gave her 52 kilograms. In the afternoon she turned every kilogram of her flour into 8 bread rolls and packed the rolls 3 to a bag. In the evening she divided the bags into 2 equal lots and gave one lot to the shelter, keeping the other. How many bags did Pia keep?
w10_T4_002990: At half past eight a car park held 17 cars. A conference brought 55 cars in, and then 3 more arrived late. At lunchtime 57 cars drove out. In the afternoon 34 cars came in for a football match. How many cars were in the car park then?
w10_T4_002994: A theatre sold 141 tickets for its Saturday show on Monday, 67 more on Tuesday, 42 on Wednesday, and 49 on Thursday. On Friday 38 tickets were refunded, and then 5 more were sold at the door. The show lasts one hundred and twenty minutes, that is, two hours, and the hall has 300 seats. Every ticket sold for 5 dollars. How many dollars did the theatre take in from the tickets that were kept?
w10_T4_002995: In the morning a stationery warehouse loaded 46 pallets onto a lorry; each pallet carried 7 boxes, each box held 3 cartons, each carton held 6 packs, and each pack held 9 pens. In the afternoon the lorry reached the shop, where everything was unpacked pen by pen onto the stockroom shelves. In the evening the shopkeeper added 22 pens from a returned order to the same shelves. How many pens were on the stockroom shelves at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_002998: A cinema has 9 screens, each with 7 rows of 45 seats, and it runs 8 shows a day on every screen. On Saturday half of all the seats across all the day's shows were sold. A private booking then added 45 more tickets. Every ticket sold for 5 dollars. The cinema opened 12 years ago. How many dollars did the cinema take in on Saturday?
w10_T4_002999: In the morning Ada unpacked 43 boxes of candles, 8 candles to a box, onto her market table, and then added 69 candles from her own workshop. In the afternoon she sold every candle on the table at 4 dollars each; the market ran for two hundred and forty minutes, four hours. In the evening she paid 1407 dollars out of that money for the month's stall rent. How many dollars did Ada have left from the day's candle money?
w10_T4_003007: In the morning a farmer delivered 207 crates of melons, with 9 melons in each crate, and split them equally among 3 shops. In the afternoon the first shop received 16 more melons from another farm. In the evening the first shop sold every melon it had at 6 dollars each. How many dollars did the first shop take in?
w10_T4_003018: Sam's phone plan had 53 minutes of call time left. The provider added a 5-minute bonus, and then Sam used 10 minutes calling his aunt. He bought a 20-minute top-up and later used 20 minutes on a work call. Sam knows sixty minutes make an hour, but the plan counts in minutes. How many minutes of call time does Sam have left?
w10_T4_003020: A teacher had 36 pencils, but 18 of them were broken and thrown away. She bought 44 new pencils and found 13 more in a cupboard after half an hour of tidying. She then shared all the pencils equally among the 5 tables in her classroom. How many pencils were put on the window table?
w10_T4_003021: Rae's stamp album had 77 pages with 3 stamps on every page. She removed 17 stamps that were damaged. Her uncle then gave her 66 stamps for the album, and she bought 58 more at a fair, adding all of them to the album. How many stamps are in Rae's album now?
w10_T4_003034: Amal's nursery had 208 saplings. She sold 132 saplings, received 13 from a supplier, and lost 15 to frost. Each remaining sapling needs 7 litres of water a day, and she watered them for 7 days, spending ninety minutes, an hour and a half, on it each morning. Her neighbour Reza's saplings used less water over the same 7 days. How many litres of water did Amal's saplings use in the 7 days?
w10_T4_003051: Rosa's bank account held 81 dollars. She paid 33 dollars for a phone bill, then deposited 40 dollars from a shift at the cafe. Her brother repaid 62 dollars he owed her, she sold an old lamp for 17 dollars, and her grandmother sent 15 dollars, all of which went into the account. Rosa tracks the account in dollars, though she knows a hundred cents make a dollar. How many dollars are in Rosa's account now?
w10_T4_003053: A school library had 82 shelves with 9 books on each shelf. A dozen volunteers sorted 70 donated books onto the shelves, and a publisher sent 55 more. During the term 459 books were lent out, and 130 worn-out books were removed. The library opened 25 years ago. Each book still on the shelves is insured for 8 dollars. How many dollars is the insurance on the books still on the shelves?
w10_T4_003056: At half past seven, 154 people were queuing outside the cinema, where tickets cost 9 dollars. The doors opened and 50 people went in, and then 78 people gave up and left. A bus dropped off 20 more people who joined the queue, and 5 latecomers arrived after them. Then 26 people were let in. How many people were still in the queue?
w10_T4_003064: In the morning a caterer had 65 guests confirmed for a dinner, and 37 more confirmed by noon. In the afternoon 4 guests cancelled, and then 10 walk-ins were added to the list. The hall has 12 windows. In the evening every guest on the list paid 6 dollars for dessert, and one table left a 28-dollar tip; the dinner lasted one hundred and fifty minutes, two and a half hours. How many dollars did the caterer collect from desserts and the tip together?
w10_T4_003066: Tia had 123 packets of sunflower seeds. She used 94 packets on the school garden and gave 20 packets to a neighbour, then bought 33 packets at the market. Each packet she has now holds 9 seeds, and she sowed every seed in her garden, which is 8 metres long. Every seed grew into a plant with 5 flower heads. How many flower heads did Tia's garden produce?
w10_T4_003071: A depot held 222 crates of honey and received 34 more. It then shipped 205 crates to a supermarket. Each remaining crate holds 9 boxes, and each box holds 9 jars, all of which were unpacked onto the depot shelves. The depot has 4 loading doors. A beekeeper then dropped off 42 loose jars for the shelves. How many jars are on the depot shelves?
w10_T4_003074: Nia had 166 stickers and gave 100 of them to her friend Ravi, who then had more stickers than Nia. She bought 26 stickers at the shop. Then she bought a matching sticker for every one she owned, so she had 2 of each. She used 32 stickers on her notebook and gave 73 to her little brother. How many stickers does Nia have now?
w10_T4_003080: Ola had 29 packets of bean seeds and gave 28 packets to the school garden club after half an hour of sorting. The packet she kept held 7 seeds. Her mother gave her 5 more seeds, and her grandmother added 49 seeds from her own jar. Ola then planted 57 seeds in the garden. How many seeds does Ola have left?
w10_T4_003082: A fruit farm had 173 rows of mango trees, but 97 rows were cleared for a new road, and then 62 new rows were planted, taking up half the eastern field. The farm covers 40 hectares. Every row has 9 trees, and every tree gave 9 kilograms of mangoes this season. A neighbour added 37 kilograms of his own mangoes to the farm's shipment. How many kilograms of mangoes were in the shipment?
w10_T4_003085: Ken's rainwater tank held 115 litres at half past six in the morning. It lost 3 litres through a leaky tap, then a shower added 62 litres. Ken used 56 litres on the vegetable beds, 37 litres on the lawn, and 54 litres washing the car. How many litres are in the tank now?
w10_T4_003089: A food bank received 14 crates of soup with 7 cans in each crate. It handed out 58 cans on Monday and received a donation of 55 cans on Tuesday. On Wednesday it gave out 56 cans, and 3 cans were found dented and thrown away. The food bank is open 5 days a week. How many cans of soup does the food bank have now?
w10_T4_003092: In the morning Jo had 45 sheets of stamps and used 17 whole sheets on a mailing. Each remaining sheet has 8 rows with 3 stamps in every row, and she peeled them all into her stamp tin. In the afternoon her aunt gave her 11 stamps for the tin. In the evening she found 25 more stamps in a drawer and added them too. How many stamps were in Jo's tin at the end of the evening?
